title: 第一卷 第333章 把帐贴出去
slug: 纨绔世子爷公主退婚我造反
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

周万金整个人晃了一下。

刘正平悄悄往后退。

陈炎看见了。

“刘秀才，你去哪儿？”

刘正平僵住。

“老朽……回去读书。”

陈炎点头。

“行，去县衙读。”

赵承轩已经带人把他按住。

就在这时，周家一个账房突然转身就跑。

红韵从人群后面出现，一把将人拎回来。

账房怀里掉出一本蓝皮账册。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Zhou Wanjin shook his whole body.

Liu Zhengping quietly stepped back.

Chen Yan saw it.

"Liu Xiucai, where are you going?"

Liu Zhengping froze.

"Old man... go back to study."

Chen Yan nodded.

"Okay, go to the county government to study."

Zhao Chengxuan had already brought people to hold him down.

At this moment, an accountant from the Zhou family suddenly turned around and ran away.

Hongyun appeared from behind the crowd and carried the person back.

A blue account book fell out of the accountant's arms.
